flows:
Navigate to https://demo.grocy.info/stockoverview then On the stock overview, find three products that show an amount in stock.
For each one, report the product name and the amount and the value shown in the overview exactly as displayed.
Then for each of those three products open its stock entries (the list of individual stock entries for that product) and report the amount of every entry exactly as displayed.
Get the product name, amount, and value shown in the overview exactly as displayed for the three products and save it as {{product_overview_details}}.
Get the amount of every individual stock entry for each of the three products exactly as displayed and save it as {{stock_entry_amounts}}.
